title: Insurance Accounts Administrator
description:
WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?
- Supportive team environment
- Opportunity to develop professional qualifications with the Chartered Institute of Insurance
- Great starting point for a career in insurance or finance
- Full support for gaining industry-recognised qualifications
- Gain experience in a well-established, global organisation

MUST HAVE'S
- GCSEs in English and Maths at Grade 5 or above (or equivalent)
- Commitment to studying and achieving Cert CII within 18-24 months
- Ability to analyse and identify key information
- Effective communication skills
- Basic problem-solving and decision-making ability
- Ability to work under guidance

NICE TO HAVE'S
- Previous work experience in insurance or related industry (not essential)
- Experience with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, SharePoint)
- Interest in developing a career within insurance broking and finance

SO, WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?
- Completing standard documents and templates accurately and efficiently
- Data entry, updating and maintaining electronic and paper files
- Responding promptly to correspondence and inquiries
- Supporting departmental reports and updating specific reports (e.g., Warranties, Cash Available, Unallocated Cash)
- Reconciling accounts and managing cash allocations
- Creating and managing statements and financial documents
- Assisting with claims and payment transactions following departmental procedures

HELPFUL EXTRAS
- On-the-job training and continuous development opportunities
- Chance to work with a diverse, inclusive team
- Exposure to international insurance operations
- Career progression opportunities within the company

Interested? Send your CV to Ellie i 2i Recruitment today!

Our mission of 'Making Recruitment Personal' also means making recruitment fair. As a result, we are committed to reviewing every application with a sense of diversity and inclusion.

We strive to personally connect with each applicant, but due to the number of applications we receive, this is not always possible. We will still aim to update you on your application, regardless of if it's successful.

title: Query Resolution Administrator 6 Month FTC
description:
As a Query Resolution Administrator in Gloucester, you'll play an important role in the Accounting & Finance department, helping to manage and resolve queries efficiently. Your work will ensure smooth communication and accurate record-keeping, supporting the business services industry.

Client Details

This role is with a company in the business services industry based in Gloucester.

Description
- Handle and resolve incoming queries related to invoices, payments, or accounts.
- Maintain accurate records of all communications and updates.
- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure timely query resolution.
- Identify recurring issues and suggest process improvements.
- Communicate effectively with clients and stakeholders to provide updates.
- Support the Accounting & Finance team with administrative tasks.
- Monitor query trends and prepare reports as needed.
- Ensure compliance with company policies and industry standards.

Profile

A successful Query Resolution Administrator should have:
- Strong organisational and communication skills.
- Knowledge of accounting or finance processes.
- Attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.
- Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
- Proficiency in using standard office software.

Job Offer
- Salary ranging from £26,500 to £28,000 dependent on the level of experience.
- Fixed-term contract based in Gloucester.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.
